Writ Petition No.15467 of 2025
O R D E R:

1. This Writ Petition is filed by the petitioners declaring the action of respondent Nos.2 to 4 in trying to dispossess the petitioners from their House properties bearing H.No.9-3-57 & 67 to 70,
H.No.9-3-64, H.No.9- 3-58, 59 & 60 and H.No.9-3-66 situated at Station Road, Khammam for demolishing the same for the purpose of widening the road without issuing any prior notice to the petitioners and without following due process of law under the provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as illegal and

2. There is no representation on behalf of the respondent Authorities.

3. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners, the respondents are directed not to dispossess or demolish the properties of the petitioners without following due process of law and the respondent authorities have to serve proper notice upon the petitioners before taking any steps with regard to widening of road in respect of their House properties 4.
With the above observation, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
5. Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.

opennyai_summary.decision:
1. This Writ Petition is filed by the petitioners declaring the action of respondent Nos.2 to 4 in trying to dispossess the petitioners from their House properties bearing H.No.9-3-57 & 67 to 70,
H.No.9-3-64, H.No.9- 3-58, 59 & 60 and H.No.9-3-66 situated at Station Road, Khammam for demolishing the same for the purpose of widening the road without issuing any prior notice to the petitioners and without following due process of law under the provisions of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as illegal and
therefore requested the Court to direct the respondents to follow due process of law for demolishing the property of the petitioners.
3. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners, the respondents are directed not to dispossess or demolish the properties of the petitioners without following due process of law and the respondent authorities have to serve proper notice upon the petitioners before taking any steps with regard to widening of road in respect of their House properties 4.
With the above observation, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
5. Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
